chinese: 有什麼我能\n為你服務的嗎？
english: Is there anything I can do for you?

chinese: 請挑選你想要\n兌換的卡片。
english: Please pick the card\nyou want to redeem.

chinese: 對不起！\n您的卡片欄已滿！

english: Which item would\nyou like to redeem?

chinese: 很抱歉！您的\n道具欄已滿！
這個道具會員\n才能兌換！
哈囉！\n一券在手，\n希望無窮！
只要一千元，\n就有獲得大獎\n的機會！
english: Just $1,000 for a\nchance at a grand\nprize!

chinese: 太可惜了！\n您的現金不足∼

嗨！
又到了每月
十五號樂透
開獎時間∼
english:
Hi! It's the 15th
again — time for the
monthly lottery
draw~

chinese: 現在馬上為您\n開出這一期的\n號碼．．。
希望下次\n得獎者就\n是您！
進來魔法屋，就得\n完全照我的指示！
english: Enter the Magic House,\nand you'll do exactly\nas I say!

chinese: 你想召喚死神，\n為你復仇嗎？
english: Do you wish to summon\nDeath to take revenge?

chinese: 你要死神附身在誰身上？
您的貸款額度\n為一百萬元。
請輸入您要貸款\n的金額！
您的貸款手續\n已經完成。
請於三個月內\n還清貸款。
很抱歉！\n金額已超過\n許可額度。
請輸入您預備\n還款的金額！
董事長親自蒞臨\n不知有何指教？
english: The Chairman himself!\nWhat can I do for you?

chinese: 請輸入您要\n週轉的金額∼
english: Enter the amount you\nwish to borrow~

chinese: 行裡現在沒有\n這麼多現金。
english: The bank doesn't have\nthat much cash.

chinese: 請輸入您要\n還款的金額∼
english: Enter the amount you\nwish to repay~

chinese: 各位客戶辛苦了！\n又到了每月銀行\n結算的日子。
english: Attention, customers!\nIt's time for the monthly bank settlement.

chinese: 大富翁銀行將\n根據您的存款，\n加發１０％的儲金利息。
english: Richman Bank will pay\n10% interest on\nyour savings.
The rest of you need\nto try harder!

chinese: 太感激了！我一\n定會報答你的！
english: Thank you so much!\nI will repay you!

chinese: 謝謝你！你真是\n我的再生父母！
我先走了！大恩\n大德來日再報！
english: I must go! I'll never\nforget this debt!

chinese: 受人點水之恩，\n必當湧泉已報！
english: A drop of kindness\nmust be repaid\nwith a spring!

chinese: 您好！請問您要替誰\n辦理出院手續？
ＯＫ！您的朋友已經\n可以出院了！
english: OK! Your friend is\nfree to go!
A plot of land is up\nfor public auction.
Congrats to John Joe on this land!

chinese: 恭喜沙隆巴斯購得此地！
english: Congrats to Salonpas on this land!
Congrats to Ninja Taro on this land!
Congrats to Madame Qian on this land!
Congrats to Uncle Tudi on this land!

chinese: 恭喜莎拉公主購得此地！
english: Congrats to Princess Sara on this land!

chinese: 恭喜宮本寶藏購得此地！
english: Congrats to Takara Miyamoto on this land!
Congrats to Sugar on this land!
Congrats to Mimi on this land!
Congrats to Sun Xiaomei on this land!
Congrats to Little Danny on this land!
Congrats to Kimi on this land!
A prisoner's sentence is extended %d days
A hospitalized patient is discharged early

chinese: 住院中病患延長住院%d天
english: A patient's hospital stay is extended %d days

chinese: 外星怪獸襲擊%s\n摧毀建築一棟
english: Alien monster attacks %s\nand destroys a building

chinese: 公開拍賣%s\n公有土地一處
公開表揚第一大地主\n%s獲得%d元獎勵
english: The top landowner is honored:\n%s wins a %d prize

chinese: 公開補助土地最少者\n%s獲得%d元補助
english: The poorest landowner is subsidized:\n%s receives %d

chinese: 公開表揚股市第一大戶\n%s獲得%d元獎勵
english: The top stockholder is honored:\n%s wins a %d prize
A house in %s is haunted.\nLand value drops 30%

chinese: %s一處民宅瓦斯爆炸\n房屋失火
english: A gas explosion in %s\nsets a house on fire

chinese: 豪雨特報\n行人休息一回合
english: Heavy rain warning!\nPedestrians skip a turn

chinese: 交通阻塞\n汽車停止一回合
english: Traffic jam!\nCars stop for a turn
A powerful quake levels buildings in %s
A flash flood washes away land in %s

chinese: 超級颱風侵襲%s\n多處房屋受損
龍捲風侵襲%s\n摧毀房屋一棟
english: A tornado hits %s\nand destroys a building
A bank run halts lending for 15 days
The bank pays a 10% interest bonus

chinese: 股市低迷不振重挫崩盤
股市氣勢如虹全面上漲
english: The stock market soars across the board
The stock market halts for 10 days
One plot of land is seized
Someone took out a fake loan in your name for %d

chinese: 支票跳票\n銀行拒絕往來一個月
english: A check bounced!\nThe bank cuts ties for a month

chinese: 侵入銀行電腦\n挪用其他人存款%d％
english: The bank computer was hacked.\n%d% of deposits stolen

chinese: 今天是你生日\n向每人收取一張卡片
english: It's your birthday!\nCollect a card from each player
Forced to travel abroad for %d days

chinese: 股票違約交割損失股票%d％
english: Stock settlement default: lose %d% of shares
Fell into a ditch. Hospitalized %d days

chinese: 騎機車未戴安全帽\n罰款%d元
請所有人吃大餐\n花費%d元
你家小狗亂大小便\n罰款%d元
誘騙未成年少女拘役%d天

english: Hi sweetheart~\nLet's go for a ride!

chinese: 此路是我開，\n此樹是我栽∼
english: This road is mine,\nI planted every tree~
Watch out! Danger at every step~
If I could return\nto the past~
Never seen a ninja\non a scooter?
Step on it and regret it!
Step aside if you\nwant to live~
The future is in\nyour own hands.

chinese: 讓我來開拓\n人生的大道∼
english: Let me pave the road\nof my life~
Ah!\nThe good old days were better.

chinese: 違章建築\n怎麼沒人管啊？
english: Why doesn't anyone\ndeal with these illegal builds?
Riding the rocket\nbike, here I come!
No way, no way!\nLet me redo that!
You'll be in trouble\nif I blow up!
This princess will\ndemolish everything in my path~
Look out for yourself,\nor heaven destroys you~

chinese: 勤快點！\n本公主\n會親自驗收！
english: Work hard!\nThis princess will\ninspect it personally!
Beep beep beep,\nleave it to me!

chinese: 趕快離開就不會\n有人受傷！！
english: Run away and\nno one gets hurt!!
Do whatever you want,\nfree as a bird!

chinese: 我可以去\n想去的地方了！
english: Now I can go\nanywhere I want!

chinese: 我來檢測大家的\n房子堅不堅固？
english: Let me test if your\nbuildings are sturdy~

chinese: 對敵人仁慈，\n就是對自己殘忍
english: Mercy to your enemy\nis cruelty to yourself

chinese: 給你面子\n才跟你換的喔！
english: I'm only trading\nout of respect for you!
Charge the sky,\nsettle on the cheap!
Follow my stock picks\nand you can't lose!
Don't even think about tax evasion!
Better to sit still\nthan make a bad move!
A good horse never\neats grass behind it!!
Try buying it — I dare you!
How dare you kick\nthe hornet's nest?!

chinese: 哼！出獄後\n又是一條好漢！
english: Hmph! Out of jail,\nI'll be back on my feet!
Don't try to take\nadvantage of me!
Lend me some money\nto tide me over!
If you like it,\nbuy it all up!
Let me do you a favor~
Hard times — selling\nthe house for cash~

chinese: 阿拉真主！\n請派使者降臨！
讓你們嚐嚐\n惡魔的厲害！
好東西要與\n好朋友分享！
english: Good things are meant\nto be shared with friends!
The net of justice\nis vast, but nothing escapes!
You want to hurt me?\nNot a chance!!
Nothing to do?\nPay some taxes then!
Who'd go to such a crooked shop?
Time for a change of pace~

chinese: 不要啦！那房子\n會漏水耶！
english: No! That house\nhas a leaky roof!
I don't want to retrace my steps~
Hmph! I do what I want, when I want~
What did I ever do to anyone?
Time for a change of feng shui!
Call a contractor\nto get an estimate!
Let me do my duty\nas your host!
There are no permanent\nenemies in this world!
I don't want to go too fast!
Ah! Too hard to turn back~
You and I have a\nserious score to settle!
A true man never\nleaves a debt unpaid!
I don't want to be\na Ninja Turtle!

chinese: 老虎不發威，\n把我當病貓？！
english: When the tiger doesn't roar,\nyou treat it like a house cat?!
Lend me some money\nto tide me over!

chinese: 不好意思，換個\n地皮你看如何？
english: Sorry, how about trading\nthis plot instead?

chinese: 換個房子\n住住看也不錯。

english: The sea of suffering is boundless —\nturn back to shore
Hard up — selling the family assets~

chinese: 小心\n別踩到狗屎啊！\n呵呵∼
english: Careful not to step in dog poop!\nHeh heh~
Don't think you\ncan push me around!
If you want to invest, follow me!

chinese: 看你一副\n逃漏稅的樣子。
租金太便宜了，\n我都沒賺到錢。
english: Rent's so cheap\nI'm not making anything.

chinese: 不覺得這條路的\n收費太貴了嗎？
english: Doesn't this road's\ntoll seem too high?
Partner with me and you can't lose!
When the mountain won't turn, the road will~
A woman's heart changes like the wind!
Is there no one to help a neighbor?
Have you no gentleness at all?!

chinese: 終於認清\n你的真面目了！
english: Now I see your true colors!
Don't try to take advantage of me!
It's fate that brought us together~
Swap a shanty for a villa!
Young folk should know when to advance or retreat!
I used to be a mason!
Build houses a whole row at a time!
Tear it down and rebuild, quick!

chinese: 我是賊仔賊公會\n的會長！
english: I'm the president of the Thieves Guild!
Early to bed means better sleep~
A soul without a body, like a scarecrow~

chinese: 別人的失敗\n就是我的快樂！
english: Other people's failures are my happiness!

chinese: 拜請拜請！\n大仙王爺公，\n小仙王爺仔∼
english: We summon you, great lords and little lords~

chinese: 阮的現金目前\n攏寄在股市∼
english: All my cash is in the stock market~
Go home and eat your own food!
You and I have a blood feud!!
Full of pain and no one knows~
How could you be so shameless!
You're a hard person to get along with!

chinese: 細漢偷挽瓠，\n大漢偷牽牛！
english: Steals gourds as a child, steals oxen as an adult!
This land is hereby annexed by the princess!
I trade with you out of respect!

chinese: 萬能的天使！\n賜給我\n神奇的力量∼

english: The best is yet to come!!
The princess will take your things!
Face the judgment of the law!
You won't get away with it!
Fortunately the princess\nhas a lucky star.
The tolls here are too low!
See the world from a different angle!
A different business might be nice~
The princess wants to enjoy the view!
Like it or not, we're trading!!
A lady's revenge\ncan wait three minutes
You won't be so lucky next time!
You dare ask for an\nalliance with ME?!
Steady hands sail for ten thousand years~
Hello! Time to split the money!

chinese: 哎呀，我真是\n太受歡迎了！
english: Oh my, I'm just SO popular!
Hoo hoo hoo, I am invincible!
Crane your neck and wait in vain!
You can stay in my\nlovely house
Want to go back\nand have a look?
Prices are soaring —\nit's a waste not to sell!
I'll rid us of this menace!

chinese: 遵照都市計畫\n建設好嗎？
english: Shall we build according\nto the city plan?
While everyone sleeps, I alone am awake~
Heh heh!\nRest up for a few days!
So mean, trying to hurt me~

chinese: 啊哈去吧∼\n沒什麼了不起∼
納稅是國民\n應盡的義務！

english: That's what it costs\nto make money!

chinese: 嗚∼\n人家花了好久\n才蓋好的∼
english: Waa~ it took me forever to build~
I'm not talking to you anymore!
Ah~ I deserve this bad luck
On credit for such a small amount~

chinese: 把錢捐給\n有需要的人吧！
english: Give the money to\nthose in need!
Mimi wants to\ntrade land with you!

chinese: 烏咪要讓這塊地\n換主人∼
english: Mimi will give this land a new owner~
Mimi commands the demon to punish you!
Ha! Raze it to the ground!
Hee! My fingers itch to demolish~
Take care of yourself, heh heh!
In the name of the moon,\nI'll punish you!!
Damn it! You're not going anywhere!
As if! You can't hurt me!
Ooh~~ stocks are about to rise!
Ooh~~ stocks are about to fall!

chinese: 這個地段\n也該漲價了吧？
english: Isn't it time this area's prices went up?
Join my side — lots of perks!
May you live as long as it does!
Mimi doesn't want to trade land

chinese: 有飯大家吃，\n有錢大家花！

english: The sea of suffering is boundless —\nturn back to shore!
Here's a new look for you!
I'll rid the people of this pest!!

chinese: 維護市容整潔\n人人有責！
english: Keeping the city clean is everyone's duty!

chinese: 你的就是我的，\n我的還是我的！
english: What's yours is mine,\nand what's mine is mine!

chinese: 休息是為了走\n更長的路！
english: Rest is preparation for a longer road!

chinese: 聯合次要敵人\n打擊主要敵人！
english: Unite with lesser enemies to defeat the main one!
I don't want to go yet~
Waa! The house I worked so hard to build~
Went for wool and came home shorn~
What gives you the right to tax me?!
Who wants to be your friend?!
Crawl, crawl across the sand river~
How dare you\ntreat me like this!
I'm the richest person on Earth
I'm going to rule these parts!

chinese: 哈哈！\n勝利總是在\n正義的一方！

english: It was just a bit of bad luck~

chinese: 我要再接再勵，\n永往直前！

english: Life rarely goes as you wish~

chinese: 我可是正正當當\n的賺錢喔！

english: Mm~ every grain of sand counts!
What's owed to you\nwill come to you!

chinese: 大家別打\n這棟房子\n的主意喔！
english: Don't anyone get ideas\nabout THIS house!
How did I end up\nbeaten by YOU?

chinese: 我的付出\n終於得到回報！

english: Why would you\ndo this to me?

chinese: 拔一毛以利\n天下不為也！
english: He won't pluck a single hair\nto help the world!
Nobody complains about too many houses!
A gentleman's revenge\ncan wait three years!
The bad luck has\nfinally left me!
I'll smile even in my dreams~
I am the Goddess of Luck!
I'll lower the price,\ncome on over!
Is it because\nI'm just too charming?

chinese: 哇∼我要過\n少奶奶的生活！
english: Wow~ time to live in luxury!

chinese: 我錢夫人不會\n就這麼放棄的！
english: Madame Qian does not\ngive up that easily!
The net shack burned, no fishing nets~
Not even enough to fill a tooth gap!
Hmph! Begging me for pocket change~
Consider it a gift\nfrom the princess

chinese: 本公主\n就是不想付，\n怎樣？
english: The princess doesn't WANT to pay. So there!

chinese: 諒你也不敢\n跟本公主收錢！
english: You wouldn't dare charge the princess!
Ha! Come if you've got a death wish!

chinese: 本公主跟你有\n深仇大恨嗎？
english: Did the princess wrong you somehow?
None of you can match me!!
Heh heh heh, I've still got it!

chinese: 呼呼呼，\n誰會來呢，\n真令人期待！
english: Hoo hoo hoo, who will come next? So exciting!

chinese: 嗨，漂亮的護士\n妹妹在哪兒？

english: Heh heh heh, success and fame!
Curse it — I refuse to believe it!
I'm not talking to you anymore!
Ah! Money's just a worldly thing~
Even the tallest tower starts from the ground!!
Let me play one more time!
It's not that I\nwon't give it to you!

chinese: 你們都不是\n烏咪的對手啦！
english: None of you can match Mimi!

chinese: 好的開始\n是成功的一半！

english: Ah~ money to ward off misfortune!
Waa~ not a single penny left.

chinese: 我不甘心！\n我要捲土重來！
english: I refuse to accept this!\nI'll make a comeback!
You can't do this to me!
